newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Hoogovens,Belgian UGB in 3.0 bln bfr steel project.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens,Belgian UGB in 3.0 bln bfr steel project.

text.p: Belgian privately-held steel firm Usines Gustave Boel (UGB) said on Thursday it had developed a partnership project with Dutch metals group Hoogovens, which involved the injection of three billion Belgian francs of fresh cash into Boel's La Louviere plant.
Boel said the deal was dependent on a restructuring at the plant involving the loss of 694 jobs.
The Boel rolling mills will help Hoogovens overcome an imbalance between its crude steel output of some six million tonnes a year and its 4.3 million tonne rolling capacity.
A major hurdle to the venture was removed last week when Boel and Belgium's largest steel maker Cockerill Sambre said they had abandoned a possible partnership due to a lack of synergies.
Talks between the two took place within the framework of efforts to create a "Great Walloon Steel Industry," a bid to preserve the steel industry in the region and the jobs it provides.
The effort was centred around loss-making Forges de Clabecq .
The European Union indicated earlier this week it would definitively block a 1.5 billion franc rescue plan for Clabecq by the Walloon region because this constituted inadmissible state aid.
The decision is a nail in the coffin of Clabecq, which analysts say, can now only survive after a thorough restructuring involving plant closures and capacity cuts, and hundreds of job losses.
